termeni-si-conditii-abonamente.title: Subscription Terms and Conditions
termeni-si-conditii-abonamente.body:
GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (T&C) – SUBSCRIPTIONS, WALLET AND LOYALTY PROGRAMME

1. Identification of the Provider and scope

1.1. The Provider is S.C. FEST4PETS S.R.L. (“FEST4PETS”, the “Clinic”, the “Provider”), whose identification details are set out in the Veterinary Medical Subscription Contract (the “Contract”).

1.2. This document (the “T&C”) governs:

(i) the use of the platform/client account;

(ii) the purchase and management of subscriptions;

(iii) recurring payments;

(iv) the operation of the Virtual Wallet (“Wallet”);

(v) the granting and use of promotional points/credits;

(vi) transfers to third-party beneficiaries;

(vii) anti-abuse rules;

(viii) communications between the parties.

1.3. The T&C apply to any natural person who creates an account, places an order, pays for a subscription, deposits money into the Wallet or uses promotional points/benefits. By accepting them, the Client confirms that they have read, understood and fully accepted these rules.

2. Contractual documents and order of precedence

2.1. The legal relationship between the parties is governed by:

(a) the Subscription Contract (the main signed document);

(b) these T&C;

(c) Annex 1 – Service Plan;

(d) any addenda/commercial confirmations.

2.2. In the event of any inconsistency, the Contract shall prevail over any other subscription document.

2.3. These T&C do not turn the subscription into insurance and do not confer any guarantee of a medical outcome.

3. Definitions

3.1. Account – the Client's digital account on the FEST4PETS platform.

3.2. Subscription – a plan of preventive/monitoring veterinary medical services, with access to preferential rates, for the contractual term, in accordance with the Contract and Annex 1.

3.3. Standard Price – the list price charged by the Clinic for individual services outside the subscription, displayed in the clinic and/or on the platform.

3.4. Recurring payment – periodic (usually monthly) automatic debiting of the payment method chosen by the Client.

3.5. Wallet – an electronic instrument for recording the Client's balances, consisting of the Nominal Balance and the Promotional Balance.

3.6. Nominal Balance (Credit) – the sums of money deposited by the Client as an advance for future services/products.

3.7. Promotional Balance (Points/Bonus) – promotional value units granted by the Provider, to be used for veterinary services, having no monetary circulation value outside the platform and not convertible into cash.

4. Account creation and access security

4.1. In order to use the digital services in full, the Client shall create an Account on the platform. The Client warrants that the data provided are genuine, complete and up to date.

4.2. The Client shall be responsible for keeping the credentials (password/codes) confidential, for the activity in the Account and for any use of the account by third parties with access to the Client's device.

4.3. In the event of suspected unauthorised access, the Client shall immediately notify the Clinic. The Provider may temporarily suspend the Account for the purposes of protection and fraud prevention.

5. Purchase and activation of the subscription

5.1. The subscription may be purchased online or at the clinic. Activation may be conditional upon identification of the animal (microchip/health booklet), confirmation of the data and the making of the first payment.

5.2. If the Plan provides for a technical activation period (e.g. 14 days), the included services may not be used during that period. The purpose is to verify the data and to configure the plan correctly.

5.3. The subscription is associated with a uniquely identified animal. The included services are non-transferable between animals, except in the situations expressly provided for as commercial facilities in the Contract/T&C.

6. Payments, invoicing and recurring payments

6.1. The Client may choose:

(a) recurring monthly payment;

(b) six-monthly payment in advance;

(c) annual payment in advance. The price, discounts and conditions are communicated before purchase and confirmed in the Contract.

6.2. For recurring payment, the Client expressly authorises the Provider to debit the chosen payment method on the established due dates. The authorisation is a repetitive payment instruction, valid until cancelled.

6.3. Payment failure (insufficient funds, expired card, bank refusal) may result in:

(i) automatic notification;

(ii) debit retry attempts;

(iii) temporary suspension of benefits;

(iv) termination of the subscription in accordance with the Contract, with application of the settlement mechanism.

The scenarios set out above shall apply successively.

6.4. The Client shall keep the payment method valid and up to date. Failing this, the Provider does not guarantee the continuity of benefits and may restrict access to the included services until the situation is remedied.

6.5. Discounts (including annual or multi-pet discounts) are conditional upon the contract/payments being kept up to date; in the event of early termination, the discount is forfeited and charges are recalculated at the Standard Price, in accordance with the Contract.

6.6. The Provider may refuse to sign a new subscription until all debts relating to the previous contract that was terminated or suspended before its term have been paid.

7. Suspension, cancellation and termination – operational rules

7.1. Temporary suspension may occur in the event of:

(a) non-payment;

(b) reasonable suspicion of fraud/abuse;

(c) major identification discrepancies;

(d) breach of the rules of conduct in the clinic.

7.2. During the suspension period, the Client may not use the included services and/or the points until the matter has been clarified and until the outstanding amounts have been brought up to date, in accordance with the subscription.

7.3. The subscription may terminate:

(a) upon expiry of its term;

(b) by unilateral termination by the Client;

(c) as a result of prolonged non-payment;

(d) upon the death of the animal (in accordance with the Contract).

7.4. Upon termination, the settlement mechanism provided for in the Contract shall apply. The T&C only detail the technical implementation (suspension of access, calculation of balances, cancellation of points).

8. Wallet – structure, top-up, use

8.1. The Wallet has two separate balances:

8.1.1. Nominal Balance (Credit) – money voluntarily deposited by the Client. It is recorded separately and may be used to pay for the services and products offered by the Clinic, including services not included in the subscription.

8.1.2. Promotional Balance (Points/Bonus) – promotional credit granted by the Provider. It does not represent money, is not convertible into cash and cannot be withdrawn. Its role is that of a commercial facility and a loyalty incentive.

8.2. The Nominal Balance may be topped up by online payment or at the clinic. The Provider may set minimum thresholds/multiples (e.g. minimum deposit) or anti-fraud limits (e.g. maximum number of deposits within a given period).

8.3. Use of the Nominal Balance: it may cover invoices for services and products in full or in part. If the Nominal Balance is insufficient, the difference shall be paid by other payment methods.

8.4. Use of the Promotional Balance: it may be used exclusively for veterinary medical labour (services), not for products/medicines/consumables. The Provider may limit the maximum percentage payable with points (e.g. max 50% of the labour) in order to ensure the economic sustainability of the programme.

8.5. Order of use (recommended rule):

(i) promotional points, then

(ii) Nominal Balance, then

(iii) external payment, except where the Client expressly requests otherwise at reception.

9. Loyalty programme – granting of bonus points

9.1. The Provider may grant bonus points depending on campaigns:

(a) Wallet deposits;

(b) annual payment;

(c) referrals;

(d) events/partnerships.

9.2. Basic rule for deposits (example): for a deposit of X lei (RON) into the Nominal Balance, the Provider may grant a bonus of X lei in promotional points, usable exclusively for labour. The percentages and conditions may vary and will be displayed on the platform at the time of the campaign.

9.3. Bonus points do not constitute a payment obligation of the Provider and may be granted/adjusted/discontinued as a matter of commercial policy, without affecting the amounts deposited by the Client in the Nominal Balance.

10. Expiry, forfeiture and cancellation of points

10.1. Promotional points have a limited validity (as a rule 12 months, unless otherwise specified in the campaign).

10.2. Points expire automatically upon the expiry of the validity period. Expiry does not give rise to any right to damages or compensation.

10.3. Points may be forfeited in whole or in part in the event of:

(a) termination of the account/contract;

(b) fraud/abuse;

(c) an attempt to convert them into money;

(d) serious breaches of the T&C.

10.4. The Provider may correct technical allocation errors (points granted in error) by adjusting the balance, with notification to the Client.

11. Withdrawals and refunds – clear rules

11.1. The Nominal Balance (money deposited) may be refunded at the Client's request only to the extent that it has not been used for purchases/services. The refund shall be made by bank transfer within 14 working days, less any bank charges.

11.2. The Promotional Balance (points) shall not be refunded, withdrawn or converted into cash in any form.

11.3. If the account is closed at the Client's initiative, the Client may request a refund of the unused Nominal Balance; the points shall be cancelled automatically.

11.4. The Provider may refuse a refund where there is a reasonable suspicion of fraud, until the checks have been completed (e.g. deposits followed by immediate withdrawal requests, reversed transactions, unpaid services, etc.).

12. Transfer to third parties (payment for other animals/persons)

12.1. The Client (the Wallet Holder) may authorise the use of the Nominal Balance and/or the points to pay for services provided for the benefit of animals belonging to third parties (“Third-Party Beneficiary”).

12.2. The authorisation may be given by:

(a) the physical presence of the Holder at the time of payment; or

(b) electronic consent via the platform or by confirmed e-mail. The authorisation must include at least: the maximum amount approved and the identity of the Third-Party Beneficiary (name and/or animal identifier – microchip).

12.3. A payment made on the basis of a valid authorisation is final and irrevocable; the Holder may not subsequently request a refund on the grounds of a change of intention.

12.4. The Provider may refuse payments to third parties if there is a suspicion of fraud or if the identification data are insufficient.

13. Anti-abuse rules and fraud prevention

13.1. Any attempt to obtain undue benefits is prohibited (e.g. use of services/points by means of false statements, manipulation of the payment system, unjustified chargebacks).

13.2. In the event of reasonable suspicion, the Provider may:

(a) suspend the account;

(b) request supporting documents;

(c) temporarily block the use of points;

(d) cancel points granted;

(e) terminate the contractual relationship in accordance with the Contract.

13.3. The Client understands that the medical services provided are documented professional acts (records, invoices) and may be used for financial settlements in accordance with the Contract.

14. Appointments, access to services and conduct in the clinic

14.1. Services are provided, as a rule, by appointment. The Clinic may set time slots dedicated to subscribers.

14.2. Failure to attend an appointment may lead to rescheduling and, in repeated cases, to the restriction of facilities.

14.3. The Client shall behave respectfully. The Clinic may refuse access in the event of aggressive behaviour, without prejudice to emergency medical obligations under professional standards.

15. Personal data and confidentiality

15.1. The Provider processes personal data (identification, contact and payment data) and data concerning the animal (medical record) for the purposes of performing the contract, administering the account and complying with legal obligations.

15.2. Processing is carried out in accordance with the applicable data protection legislation (GDPR). Further details may be included in a Privacy Policy published on the platform.

15.3. The Client consents to operational communications (confirmations, payment notifications, information about the subscription). Marketing communications shall be sent only with separate consent, where applicable.

16. Amendment of the T&C and continuity of contracts

16.1. The Provider may amend the T&C to reflect operational, legislative or commercial changes.

16.2. Amendments are published on the platform and apply from the date indicated. For existing contracts, amendments affecting essential rights shall apply only after the Client has been informed and, where applicable, after the necessary consent has been obtained.

16.3. If the Client does not accept the amendments, the Client may stop using the platform and may terminate the subscription in accordance with the Contract.

17. Governing law and dispute resolution

17.1. The T&C are governed by Romanian law.

17.2. The parties shall seek to settle any dispute amicably; failing that, the jurisdiction established in the Subscription Contract shall apply.

18. Final provisions

18.1. If a clause is declared null and void, the remainder of the T&C shall remain applicable (severability).

18.2. Failure by the Provider to exercise a right shall not constitute a waiver of that right.

18.3. The Client confirms having understood:

(i) the distinction between the Nominal Balance and points;

(ii) that points are not money;

(iii) that the use of promotional benefits is conditional upon compliance with the rules above.

contract-abonament.title: Subscription Contract
contract-abonament.body:
VETERINARY MEDICAL SUBSCRIPTION CONTRACT

No. ____ / Date ____

I. THE CONTRACTING PARTIES

1. The Provider

S.C. FEST4PETS S.R.L., with its registered office in the Municipality of Târgu Mureș, Mureș County, registered with the Trade Register Office (ORC) under no. J26/1060/2022, CUI (tax identification code) RO46349603, legally represented by Dr. Festeu Radu-Andreias, administrator and veterinarian, hereinafter referred to as the “Provider” or the “Clinic”.

2. The Client

Mr./Ms. ________________________, CNP (personal numeric code) __________________, residing at ______________________,

identified by ID card series ___ no. ___, telephone __________, e-mail __________, hereinafter referred to as the “Client”, being in possession of the animal identified by

Animal name ______________________ Species ______________________ Breed ______________________

Sex ______________________ Weight ______________________ Microchip/Health booklet no. ______________________,.

II. SUBJECT MATTER AND LEGAL NATURE OF THE CONTRACT

This contract is a contract for the provision of veterinary medical services within the meaning of Article 1851 et seq. of the Civil Code.

The subject matter of this document is the purchase by the Client of a FEST4PETS Veterinary Medical Subscription, which provides access to preventive and monitoring veterinary medical services, at preferential rates, on the basis of a personalised plan for the animal identified above.

The Client declares that they have been informed and understand that the subscription:

– is a service contract, not insurance;

– does not guarantee the recovery or survival of the animal;

– does not constitute a refundable deposit of money;

– is based on the veterinarian's obligation of diligence

III. IDENTIFICATION OF THE ANIMAL

The services shall be provided exclusively for the animal identified in Annex 1. The subscription is non-transferable.

IV. TERM

The Contract is concluded for 12 months. Renewal shall take place only with the express consent of the Client.

V. PRICE, PAYMENTS AND DISCOUNTS

Payment may be made monthly, six-monthly or annually.

Annual or biannual payment benefits from a discount, conditional upon the contract being maintained for its entire term.

The amounts paid are non-refundable.

VI. UNILATERAL TERMINATION, TERMINATION FOR BREACH AND SETTLEMENT

The Client may unilaterally terminate the contract by written notice communicated to the Provider in advance, at least 30 days before the date on which the termination of the contract is intended to take effect.

In the event of early termination:

– the services used shall be recalculated at the standard price;

– discounts shall be forfeited automatically;

– the differences shall become due and payable.

Any differences shall be paid by bank transfer within 14 days of the date of termination of the contract.

VII. DEATH OR LOSS OF THE ANIMAL

If the animal is lost, given away or, unfortunately, dies, the subscription stops.

The amounts are not refunded automatically; the subscription is suspended. The Client may choose for the amount relating to the suspended contract to be offered as a commercial facility in the form of service credit for another animal, or to have it refunded to them, in which case the effects of the contract cease, for the reasons mentioned above.

Refunds of any differences shall be made by bank transfer within 14 days of the date of termination of the contract

The Clinic will convert the positive balance into service credit, valid for 12 months, in the Client's account on the platform, which may subsequently be reused by the same owner or transferred to a third party, provided that such person holds an active veterinary services subscription with the clinic.

VIII. WALLET AND POINTS

The use of the Wallet is governed by the Terms and Conditions.

Promotional points confer only a right to the provision of certain services under the conditions stipulated in the guide and the contract; they are not money, are not convertible and do not constitute a claim.

IX. LIABILITY

The Clinic has an obligation of diligence, not an obligation of result.

It shall not be liable for the worsening of pre-existing conditions or for failure to comply with medical instructions.

X. FORCE MAJEURE

In accordance with Article 1351 of the Civil Code.

XI. DISPUTES

Disputes shall be settled by the competent courts in Târgu Mureș.

XII. FINAL PROVISIONS

The Client declares that they have read, understood and fully accept this contract.

anexa-abonamente.title: Subscription Annex
anexa-abonamente.body:
ANNEX NO. 1 – PERSONALISED VETERINARY MEDICAL SERVICE PLAN

This annex forms an integral part of the Veterinary Medical Subscription Contract concluded between S.C. FEST4PETS S.R.L. and the Client and sets out in detail the veterinary medical services included in the subscription, the conditions of use and the applicable technical limits.

1. Legal nature and purpose of the service plan

1.1. The veterinary medical service plan is a structured set of preventive medical acts and acts for monitoring the health of the animal, offered under the subscription.

1.2. This annex does not constitute an insurance contract, does not involve the assumption of any risk and does not guarantee the recovery, favourable progress or survival of the animal.

1.3. The services are provided on the basis of an obligation of diligence, in accordance with the legislation specific to the veterinary profession and the rules of the College of Veterinary Physicians of Romania.

2. Principle of personalisation of service packages

2.1. The service packages are NOT standardised in the form of fixed categories (such as Basic, Plus, Premium, etc.).

2.2. Each service plan is individually personalised at the time of contracting, depending on:

a) the species of the animal (dog, cat, other eligible species);

b) the breed and known genetic particularities;

c) the sex and hormonal status (intact / neutered);

d) body weight;

e) biological age;

f) lifestyle (indoor / outdoor);

g) known chronic conditions or identified risk factors.

2.3. Personalisation aims to adapt the frequency and type of services to the actual needs of the animal, without altering the legal nature of the subscription.

3. Establishment and confirmation of the personalised plan

3.1. The personalised plan is established by the veterinarian on the basis of the information provided by the Client and the initial medical assessment.

3.2. The content of the plan (list of services and annual limits) is communicated to the Client before the subscription is activated.

3.3. The Client confirms the personalised plan by signing the Contract and this annex.

3.4. Subsequent adjustments may be recommended for medical reasons, without giving rise to refund rights or unilateral price changes, except in situations agreed by the parties.

4. Categories of included services

Depending on the personalised plan, the subscription may include, without being limited to, the following categories of services:

4.1. Consultations and clinical assessments

– periodic general consultations;

– monitoring check-ups;

– preventive clinical assessments.

4.2. Prophylaxis and prevention

– vaccinations according to the recommended schedule;

– internal and external parasite treatments;

– nutrition and weight management assessments.

4.3. Paraclinical investigations

– haematological tests (complete blood count);

– biochemical tests;

– coproparasitological tests;

– urinalysis and urine culture.

4.4. Imaging investigations

– abdominal ultrasound;

– X-rays, within the limit of medically recommended exposures.

4.5. Routine procedures

– dental scaling;

– nail trimming;

– anal gland expression;

4.6. Complementary services

– video consultations (veterinary telemedicine);

– home visits, if included in the personalised plan.

5. Usage limits and frequency

5.1. Each included service has a maximum annual limit, established according to the personalised plan.

5.2. The limits are set in order to ensure a balance between effective prevention and responsible use of medical resources.

5.3. The included limits may be exceeded at the Client's request, with the additional services being paid at the Standard Price, applying any contractual discounts.

6. Conditions of use of the services

6.1. Services are provided, as a rule, by prior appointment.

6.2. The provision of services is conditional upon compliance with medical instructions and appointments.

6.3. Failure to use an included service within a given period does not give rise to any right to financial compensation or carry-over, unless expressly provided for in the Contract.

7. Exclusions and services not included

7.1. Unless expressly provided for in the personalised plan, the subscription does not include:

– major surgical procedures;

– prolonged hospitalisation;

– oncological treatments;

– medicines, vaccines and consumables;

– emergency procedures outside the clinic's opening hours.

7.2. These services may be provided separately, at the Standard Price.

8. Non-transferability

8.1. The included services are non-transferable and may be used exclusively for the animal identified in the Contract; they may be transferred only at the Client's written request.

8.2. Any attempt to use them for another animal without the Client's consent (in person or by confirmed e-mail) shall result in the forfeiture of the related benefits, without any right to a refund.

9. Relationship with the other contractual documents

9.1. This annex is supplemented by the provisions of the Veterinary Medical Subscription Contract and of the General Terms and Conditions.

9.2. In the event of any inconsistency between the documents referred to in point 9.1 (above), the provisions of the Contract shall prevail.

ghid-proprietar.title: Owner's Guide
ghid-proprietar.body:
PET OWNER'S GUIDE

The FEST4PETS Health Subscription – clear, predictable, personalised

Why this guide?

We have created this guide to explain, in clear and transparent language, what the FEST4PETS Health Subscription is and how it works. The document may be read as it stands or sent in full as an informative e-mail to pet owners interested in a modern veterinary care solution.

1. What is the FEST4PETS Health Subscription?

The FEST4PETS Health Subscription is a smart way for you to plan your veterinary expenses in advance and make sure that your animal benefits from prevention, monitoring and quick access to veterinary medical services.

Instead of paying large, unexpected sums when a problem arises, you pay in instalments and have predictable costs throughout the year.

2. What this subscription is NOT

It is important to know from the outset what the subscription is NOT:

– it is not insurance;

– it does not guarantee the recovery or survival of the animal;

– it is not a deposit of money that can be withdrawn at any time;

– it does not replace the owner's responsibility for the animal's health.

It is a veterinary services contract, built fairly and transparently.

3. Why it is different from other “packages”

At FEST4PETS there are no standard packages such as Basic, Plus or Premium.

Each subscription is personalised for your animal, depending on:

– species;

– breed;

– sex and hormonal status;

– weight;

– age;

– lifestyle (indoor/outdoor);

– any conditions or risks identified.

This way, you pay only for what makes medical sense for your animal.

4. What services can be included

Depending on the personalised plan, the subscription may include:

– veterinary consultations;

– vaccinations and parasite treatments;

– blood and urine tests;

– ultrasounds and X-rays;

– routine procedures (dental scaling, nail trimming, etc.);

– video consultations;

– discounts on services or products not included.

The exact list is established together with the veterinarian.

5. How payment works

You can choose monthly, six-monthly or annual payment.

Annual or six-monthly payment may include a financial advantage, provided that the subscription is maintained for the agreed term.

The subscription is designed for continuity and prevention, not for one-off use.

6. What happens if you cancel

You can cancel at any time.

In this case, the services already used are recalculated at the standard price, and any differences are settled in accordance with the contract.

The subscription does not work like a bank loan or like insurance.

7. What happens in unforeseen situations

If the animal is lost, given away or, unfortunately, dies, the subscription stops.

The amounts are not refunded automatically; the subscription is suspended. The Client may choose for the amount relating to the suspended contract to be offered as a commercial facility in the form of service credit for another animal, or to have it refunded to them, in which case the effects of the contract cease, for the reasons mentioned above.

8. The Wallet – a modern way to set money aside

On the FEST4PETS platform you can have a Wallet (virtual wallet).

You can deposit money at any time, in any amount, so that it is available when you need it.

For these deposits, the Clinic will offer extra bonus points of the same value as the amount deposited; the points received may be used for medical labour, while the amounts deposited may be used both for purchasing products and for medical services.

Points are not money and cannot be withdrawn, but they represent a real advantage for owners.

9. Who this subscription is for

The subscription is ideal for:

– owners who want predictable costs;

– young, growing animals;

– adult animals that require monitoring;

– families with several animals;

– people who want prevention, not just emergency treatment.

10. Why choose FEST4PETS

Because at FEST4PETS:

– the plan is medically personalised, not commercially standardised;

– you know from the start what you are paying and what for;

– you have quick access to services;

– we build a long-term relationship based on prevention.

If you want a modern approach to your animal's health, the FEST4PETS Health Subscription is the right solution.

11. How you can get started

You can contact us directly at the clinic, by telephone or online.

A veterinarian will help you so that, together, we can build a plan tailored to your animal.
